sections: 17.6 airport surface access where service exists
interpretation: Actual flight-passenger-only shuttle is qualified topology, not general PUBLIC access. Existing airport structural check may be satisfied only by two independently validated rides and qualified national paths; original check/default failure retained. No automatic customer entitlement, lodging-visitor claim, booking/capacity/live-dispatch promise, or timed itinerary. Public park ownership does not make shuttle eligibility unrestricted.
